map.请柬 200 张 × 3 元 = 600 元；桌卡 30 个 × 8 元 = 2: Invitations 200 × ¥3 = ¥600; table cards 30 × ¥8 = ¥240; balloons 50 × ¥2 = ¥100; favor boxes 200 × ¥6 = ¥1,200. Total ¥2,140 across 4 items. If the invitations and favor boxes have arrived, the table cards are ordered and the balloons are still to order, completion = 2 ÷ 4 = 50% — 2 received, 1 ordered, 1 to order.
